### Love One Another Gladly
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/love-one-another-gladly
Passage: Micah 6:8
Points:
- Genuine love finds delight in helping and blessing others rather than acting out of mere begrudging obligation.
- Micah 6:8 calls believers not merely to execute acts of kindness, but to genuinely love kindness.
- Being born of God grants spiritual power that overcomes our worldly aversion to His commands.
- Obeying God and showing love to others should be marked by gladness rather than a sense of burden.

### What Does the Lord Require of Us?
Author: Megan J. Conner
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/what-does-the-lord-require-of-us-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Micah 6:8
Points:
- While modern culture overwhelms people with endless directives, God simplifies our duty to loving Him and others.
- Acting justly means extending the same fairness and respect to our neighbors that we desire for ourselves.
- Showing kindness and mercy takes conscious, intentional practice amid personal busyness and distractions.
- Walking humbly requires putting aside pride and self-righteousness, knowing all people stand equal before God.
